$Comment: The goblin builder on the temple hub's Concourse, hammering at the pipe in its unfinished south-east corner: a Custom anchor on the Concourse's Builder spot (Provider ziggfreedcommon:hub), so he follows the Concourse to whatever lot it stands on and is simply absent when it stands nowhere. Interact.Enabled false: pressing F on him opens nothing, since he is part of the place (his role, the lab's repairer, has no press-F of its own either). Switch him off in mods/ziggfreedcommon/npc-placements.json with { "Zc_Hub_Builder": { "Enabled": false } }.
Name: Zc_Hub_Builder
